The Datalabs Agency understands the need for creativity in dashboard and report design – from what data to use, to the insights selected, to the final user experience (UX). Our Microsoft Power BI dashboard designers in Australia start with a simple idea: make intuitive, impactful dashboards that get answers visualized — memorably and beautifully.

We work with companies and government agencies across Australia and internationally — financial services, pharma, government, automotive, energy. In-person in Melbourne, or remotely anywhere.

We are not your stale, old-school consultancy. We think there’s more to designing effective dashboards than choosing a bar graph or a pie chart.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="dfd_col-tablet-6" width="1/3" offset="vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-4 vc_col-xs-12"][dfd_info_box module_animation="transition.slideLeftIn" icon="dfd-icon-user_like" delimiter_style="dashed" line_hide="yes" style="style-01" title="It's All About the User" icon_size="45" icon_color="#000000" icon_hover="#999999" icon_bg_size="45" title_font_options="tag:h3|line_height:38" subtitle_font_options="tag:h4|font_style_italic:1" font_options="tag:div" layout="layout-06" subtitle="Do you know your audience?" line_width="35" line_border="5" line_color="#474747"]User-centric data design is all we do.
